judgments.concern: on_pair already keeps every class-matched DetectionCandidate and already sends only the select_detection choice into estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. Each candidate has source_index, its slot in that Detection2DArray. publish_ok_diagnostics and publish_failure_diagnostics already attach input_rgb_stamp and input_depth_stamp, and DiagnosticStatus.values is an open list of string KeyValues, so the other indices can be added on those two paths once the publishers receive the candidate list. Two earlier returns publish nothing: select_detection returning nullopt, and depth_image_to_meters throwing, so those pairs leave every detection unmarked. The chosen source_index is stored as PoseResult.instance_id and is not copied onto the diagnostic status. The only diagnostics subscriber in this package, eval_recorder_node, skips OK statuses and on WARN keeps only failure_reason, so deferred keys on a successful pose are dropped by that consumer. source_index is a per-frame array slot, not an id that stays with one pallet across captures.

Inside estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 the plane inliers exist only as the locals plane_points_3d and obs_points_2d, projected on build_plane_basis_deterministic's axis_u and axis_v, and both are discarded on return. PoseResult and ChamferDebugV3_2 carry the centre, yaw, normal, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, and chamfer debug; PalletPoseStamped publishes that same set and has no width, height, or depth fields. A span along those plane axes is the column range of obs_points_2d and can be filled only before return. Those axes come from the camera-up hint. The in-plane rotation best_pose.theta_rad is stored only as debug.chamfer_theta_rad, which the node does not publish, so the span is not the pallet's own face width and height. The depth-to-RGB transform already applied is apply_se3 of the chamfer centre into pose.tz, plus R_dr on the normal. The inliers stay in the depth frame. Their mean z in the RGB frame needs apply_se3_batch(plane_points_3d, R_dr, t_dr) inside the estimator, and that mean is a different quantity from pose.tz. The node cannot rebuild either extent from the pose it already publishes.

cached_prototype builds the chamfer contour from EstimatePoseParams pallet_width_m 1.20 and pallet_height_m 0.14, and PalletPoseNode leaves params_ at those defaults. obs_points_2d exists before that call, so its axis-aligned range could be passed as those two sizes. The pipeline never recovers a face width or height from the inliers, and the plane basis is fixed before the search. best_pose.theta_rad, the rotation that would separate face width from face height, is an output of matching the prototype, so it cannot size the prototype it depends on. build_default_pallet_prototype still places pockets from the factory pocket_width_m 0.47, pocket_height_m 0.10, and pocket_centre_offset_m 0.28, which are not scaled with the outer rectangle. Those pockets lie inside a 1.20 m by 0.14 m face and fall outside an outer rectangle whose width is below about 1.03 m or whose height is below 0.10 m. The observation raster is built from the inlier points before the prototype, and the search steps stay the fixed EstimatePoseParams windows. A prototype taken from the inlier bounding span is a box around those same points, with the factory pockets, rather than a template of one pallet face.
